early: The Crypt was always going to win. It has had a thousand years of practice.
The dead here have seen this before. They are not impressed.
Malachar did not even notice. The Crypt is patient.
The bones on the floor shifted to make room. They have done this many times.
The silence returned before you finished falling.
mid: You made it deeper than most. The Crypt acknowledges this by doing nothing.
The undead carry you to the entrance without ceremony. They have a system.
Floor {floor}. Malachar counted. He does not look up from his work.
You were close. The Crypt disagrees with your definition of close.
The torches burned on after you fell. They always do.
late: Floor {floor}. The boss could hear your footsteps. It was ready.
You reached the deep Crypt. Almost no one does. That is the only comfort available.
The ancient dead watched you fall. They respected the effort. They will not remember your name.
So close. The Crypt has heard that before. It is unmoved.
boss: Malachar has stood since the first age. You are not the first to challenge him. You are not the last.
The Undying King endures. You did not. This is the natural order of the Crypt.
Malachar returned to his throne. Your name was not added to his records.

early: The fire did not notice you leave. It was busy.
The Wastes absorbed you. This is what they do.
Ash to ash. The Wastes appreciate the symmetry.
The heat was waiting for you. It waited until floor {floor}.
You burned. The Wastes continued burning. No difference was noted.
mid: Floor {floor}. The Wastes have claimed stronger than you.
The fire has been burning for a thousand years. You lasted {floor} floors. The math is unkind.
Something in the Wastes made a sound that might have been a laugh. You will never know.
The ash settled over you. It settles over everything eventually.
late: The Eternal Pyre was visible from where you fell. You almost reached it.
Floor {floor}. The heat at this depth breaks stone. You lasted longer than stone.
The oldest fire in the world watched you fall. It has watched everything fall.
boss: The Eternal Pyre burns on. It has always burned. It will always burn. You did not change this.
The Ashen King rules still. The Wastes are unchanged. The fire did not mourn you.
You reached the source of the fire. The fire was not grateful.

early: The cold took you on floor {floor}. It takes everyone eventually.
The Abyss is patient. The cold is patient. You were not patient enough.
The ice sealed over the gap you left. The Abyss does not leave gaps.
The frozen dead watched you fall. They have been watching this place for centuries.
The cold did not hurry. It never hurries. It simply waits.
mid: Floor {floor}. The cold gets heavier the deeper you go. You found that out.
The Abyss swallowed you quietly. It swallows everything quietly.
Something frozen and ancient noted your passing. Then returned to waiting.
The ice closed. The silence returned. Nothing changed in the Frosthold Abyss.
late: So deep. The cold at floor {floor} is a different kind of cold. You know that now.
The Frozen King was one floor away. You almost reached the bottom of the world.
The Abyss acknowledges floor {floor}. It acknowledges nothing else.
boss: The Eternal Winter endures. Winter always endures. Spring does not reach the Abyss.
The Frozen King has ruled since before the Abyss had a name. You did not end his reign.
The cold is permanent. Your run was not. The Abyss observes the difference.

early: The Archives have recorded millions of deaths. Yours is entry {kills} this century.
The drowned scholars noted your passing. They file everything.
The water closed over floor {floor}. It closes over everything down here.
You are in the Archives now. The entry is brief. The filing system is meticulous.
The ink in the Archives never dries. Your name has been added. In the margin.
mid: Floor {floor}. The Archives record this. They record everything.
A drowned librarian retrieved your belongings. They will be catalogued.
The Archives absorb everything that enters and does not leave. You are part of the collection now.
The water is very still at floor {floor}. You found out why.
late: The restricted section was close. The Archives do not let anyone reach the restricted section.
Floor {floor}. The Head Archivist has seen stronger challengers. He has filed them all.
Whatever is in the deepest stacks of the Archives, you did not reach it. It is still there.
boss: The Sunken Archives have stood since the world had a different shape. You did not reshape them.
The Head Archivist returns to his work. Your file has been sealed.
The Archives are patient. They have time. All the time in the world, at the bottom of the world.

early: The house was not finished with you on floor {floor}. The house is never finished.
Something in the Hollow smiled. You did not see it. You were already falling.
The candles burned on. They always burn in the Hollow. You just could not see them anymore.
The Hollow absorbed you quietly. It has practice.
A door closed somewhere in the house. You had nothing to do with it. The house just closes doors.
mid: Floor {floor}. The Hollow had been watching since you arrived. It was not in a hurry.
The portraits in the hall all turned to face the same direction. Away from where you fell.
The music box played one note, then stopped. Then the Hollow went quiet.
Something in the house made a sound like breathing. Then it stopped. Then there was only you, falling.
The Hollow keeps what it takes. It has kept many things.
late: So deep in the house. The rooms at floor {floor} have not had a living visitor in decades.
The Last Resident was one floor below. The house knew. The house was patient.
You could hear something at the bottom of the stairs. You almost found out what it was.
The Hollow gives floor {floor} to very few. It takes them all back eventually.
boss: The House Itself endures. Houses outlast everything. They outlasted you.
The Last Resident has always been here. Will always be here. You were a visitor.
The Hollow is quiet again. It prefers quiet. It prefers to be alone with its dead.
medusa: You met her eyes. The house was the last thing you saw. The Hollow has a new statue.
She did not mean to. She never means to. The Hollow has a new addition to its collection.
Stone. Cold. Still. The Hollow preferred you this way.
lord_phorcys: Lord Phorcys found what he was looking for. It was not his daughter.
He was not angry. Just broken. You were simply in the way.
He has been walking the Hollow for years. He will keep walking.
weeping_child: The child you woke is still crying somewhere in the Hollow. It will cry for a long time.
You found the child but could not comfort it. The Hollow noticed. The Hollow always notices.
The Weeping Child watched you fall. It has seen this before. Everyone falls eventually.
music_box: The melody played to the empty room after you fell. Three ticks. Then silence.
The Music Box wound itself again. It always does. It played for no one.
The melody of the Music Box was the last thing you heard. It was not comforting.
oldest_guest: The Oldest Guest has been here since before the house had a name. You were not the first. You will not be the last.
The Oldest Guest does not hurry. He has time. All the time in the world, in that house.
He was sitting in the same chair when you arrived. He will be sitting there long after.

early: The Forest whispered your name on floor {floor}. You should not have stopped to listen.
The trees remember everything that happens between them. They will remember you.
Something in the undergrowth watched you fall. It had been watching since you entered.
The Forest is patient. It has been here longer than the paths through it.
The whispers were not warning you. They were describing you. Past tense.
mid: Floor {floor}. The Forest had been narrowing the path since you arrived.
The canopy closed over where you fell. By morning no light will reach that spot.
The roots moved after. They always move after. The Forest prefers things tidy.
A bird called somewhere above. Then silence. The Forest went back to whispering.
The corruption was never the enemy. The Forest was always the enemy.
late: This deep in the Forest the trees have names. They know yours now.
Floor {floor}. The witch's curse found you eventually. It finds everyone eventually.
The path closed behind you weeks ago. You just did not notice until now.
Something ancient in the wood exhaled. It had been holding its breath since you entered.
boss: The Forest endures. It was here before the witch. It will be here after you.
Seraphine does not die. She waits. She has been waiting longer than the Forest has had a name.
The Corrupter was never an enemy you could fight. It is the Forest. And the Forest won.

early: The void on floor {floor} had been waiting for something to fill it. It found you.
The Descent swallowed you quietly. It has had practice.
The darkness here is not an absence of light. It is a substance. You fell into it.
Something in the void noted your passing. It did not care. Nothing here cares.
The Descent goes deeper. You simply stopped going with it.
mid: Floor {floor}. The void gets heavier the further down you go. You found the weight of it.
The things that live here do not sleep. They watched you fall without expression.
The Descent did not notice you leave. It does not notice anything. It simply is.
The darkness closed over where you had been standing. Perfectly.
You lasted longer than most. The void has seen many. It will see many more.
late: This deep in the Descent the void has texture. You fell through several layers of it.
Floor {floor}. The Architect was one floor below. It knew you were coming.
Something in the dark exhaled. Whether in hunger or satisfaction, there was no way to know.
The Descent keeps going below where you fell. It keeps going for a very long time.
boss: The Architect built this place. It is still building. You were never more than material.
The Hard Void has existed since before the concept of light. You were a brief interruption.
The void reasserted itself. It always does. It is very patient about these things.

early: The water on floor {floor} closed over you without a sound. The Deep does not make speeches.
The pressure down here changes things. It changed you. Permanently.
Something vast moved in the water below where you fell. It did not stop moving.
The Deep has been swallowing things since before the surface existed. You were not exceptional.
The current took you. The current takes everything eventually.
mid: Floor {floor}. The light stopped reaching this far down a long time ago.
The creatures of the Deep watched without eyes. They sense pressure. They sensed you stop.
The water here is cold in a way that is not about temperature. You found that out.
The Leviathan turned, somewhere below. It felt the ripple of your falling.
The Deep is very quiet now. It was quiet before you arrived. It is quiet again.
late: This close to the bottom. The pressure is not something you survive. Most of the time.
Floor {floor}. The Leviathan was one floor below. Four thousand years old and patient.
The void at the bottom of the ocean is different from other voids. Wetter. You found out.
Something ancient in the Deep exhaled. Bubbles rose past where you fell. They made it to the surface.
boss: The Leviathan is four thousand years old. It has outlasted everything that has tried to end it. Including you.
The Deep reclaimed you. It reclaims everything. The ocean is patient in the way that only oceans can be.
The Leviathan sank back into the abyss. It will be there when the next one comes. It is always there.

Crypt of Malachar: The Crypt does not mourn you. It simply continues.
Malachar has waited a thousand years. He can wait a little longer.
Your bones will keep the others company.
The silence returned before you finished falling.
You lasted longer than most. That is not a compliment.
The Ashbound Wastes: The fire noticed you. Then it stopped noticing you.
The ash is indifferent. The ash is always indifferent.
You burned. Everything here burns eventually.
The Wastes did not hate you. They simply consumed you.
Frosthold Abyss: The cold does not celebrate. It simply remains.
The journals of this expedition will not return to the surface.
Whatever waits at the bottom heard you coming. Now it does not hear you.
The ice closes over the gap you left. As if you were never here.
The Abyss keeps everything it touches. Forever.

nightmareDefeatQuotes: It does not remember you. Nothing here remembers anything.
You were here. Now you are part of it.
The nightmare does not end when you do.
It watched you the whole time. You never saw it.
Some doors, once opened, do not close from this side.

Crypt of Malachar.Warrior: You held the shield. The dead fell behind it. Malachar did not expect a wall.
Crypt of Malachar.Monk: You moved like water through the Crypt. The dead could not touch what they could not follow.
Crypt of Malachar.Assassin: The Crypt never saw you coming. Neither did Malachar.
Crypt of Malachar.Paladin: The divine light you carried was the first light the Crypt had seen in a thousand years.
Crypt of Malachar.Naturalist: Life followed you through the Crypt. The dead were not prepared for that.
Crypt of Malachar.Sorcerer: The Crypt is made of old magic. Yours was newer. Yours was louder.
Crypt of Malachar.Necromancer: You spoke the language of this place fluently. Malachar did not appreciate the accent.
Crypt of Malachar.Berserker: The Crypt tried to break you. You broke it first.
Crypt of Malachar.Bard: You sang in the Crypt. The dead listened. Then they stopped moving.
Crypt of Malachar.Alchemist: You turned the Crypt's own rot against it. Elegant, in a way.
Crypt of Malachar.BloodKnight: Blood answered blood in the Crypt. Yours was the louder conversation.
Crypt of Malachar.Druid: You brought something living into a place that forgot what living meant.
Crypt of Malachar.Wizard: The Crypt runs on death magic that is centuries old. Your arcane study found the seams. You pulled them apart.

The Ashbound Wastes.Warrior: The Wastes burned. You did not. That is the whole story.
The Ashbound Wastes.Monk: You found stillness in the Wastes. The fire could not reach what was already calm.
The Ashbound Wastes.Assassin: The Wastes saw everything. Somehow you still found shadows.
The Ashbound Wastes.Paladin: Your faith burned hotter than the Wastes. The Pyre could not compete.
The Ashbound Wastes.Naturalist: You found life in a place that incinerated it. That is not supposed to be possible.
The Ashbound Wastes.Sorcerer: You met fire with fire. Yours was better fire.
The Ashbound Wastes.Necromancer: Even the ash listened to you. The dead here were just waiting for direction.
The Ashbound Wastes.Berserker: The Wastes tried to make you rage. You were already raging. You won.
The Ashbound Wastes.Bard: You sang in the fire. The Wastes had never heard music before. They did not survive it.
The Ashbound Wastes.Alchemist: You turned the fire into something useful. That is disgusting and impressive.
The Ashbound Wastes.BloodKnight: You bled in the Wastes. The Wastes bled back. You had more to give.
The Ashbound Wastes.Druid: After you left, something small and green grew in the ash. That has never happened before.
The Ashbound Wastes.Wizard: The fire here is ancient and specific. You studied it. You named it. Then you ended it.

Frosthold Abyss.Warrior: The cold tried to stop you. You stopped it instead.
Frosthold Abyss.Monk: You found warmth inside yourself in the coldest place in the world.
Frosthold Abyss.Assassin: The Abyss watches everything. You moved anyway. Fast enough.
Frosthold Abyss.Paladin: The cold cannot touch what the divine has already claimed.
Frosthold Abyss.Naturalist: The Abyss had never seen warmth before you arrived. It has now.
Frosthold Abyss.Sorcerer: The Abyss is old cold magic. You brought new hot magic. The math worked out.
Frosthold Abyss.Necromancer: The frozen dead rose at your command. They were glad to move again.
Frosthold Abyss.Berserker: You were angrier than the cold. The cold backed down.
Frosthold Abyss.Bard: The Abyss has been silent forever. Not anymore.
Frosthold Abyss.Alchemist: You melted the Abyss with science. That is technically what happened.
Frosthold Abyss.BloodKnight: Your blood ran warm in the Abyss. It is still warm. You kept it.
Frosthold Abyss.Druid: Spring is coming to the Frosthold Abyss. You started it.
Frosthold Abyss.Wizard: The Abyss is the purest cold you have ever studied. Your notes filled sixteen pages. Then you destroyed it.

The Sunken Archives.Warrior: The Archives recorded everything. Including you. The entry is complimentary.
The Sunken Archives.Monk: You read the Archives without disturbing a single page. The librarians would approve.
The Sunken Archives.Assassin: The Archives catalogued millions of deaths. They were not prepared to catalogue their own.
The Sunken Archives.Paladin: The divine light you carried dried the Archives out. First time in centuries.
The Sunken Archives.Naturalist: You found things living in the Archives that the scholars missed. They were important.
The Sunken Archives.Sorcerer: The Archives contained spells older than language. You improved on several.
The Sunken Archives.Necromancer: The drowned scholars rose to help you. Professional courtesy.
The Sunken Archives.Berserker: You went through the Archives like water. Fast water. Loud water.
The Sunken Archives.Bard: You are in the Archives now. Chapter twelve. The title is flattering.
The Sunken Archives.Alchemist: You extracted something from the Archives that was not supposed to be extractable.
The Sunken Archives.BloodKnight: The Archives recorded your bloodline. It is impressive. Do not ask how they know.
The Sunken Archives.Druid: The waterlogged plants in the Archives have started growing again. You did that.
The Sunken Archives.Wizard: The Archives held more arcane knowledge than any library above the water. You memorized most of it. You destroyed the rest.

The Hollow.Warrior: The Hollow tried to break you with silence. You were louder.
The Hollow.Monk: The Hollow is full of echoes. You left only one. Your footsteps leaving.
The Hollow.Assassin: The house watched. You were faster than what it was watching for.
The Hollow.Paladin: The Hollow had not felt holy light in a very long time. It remembered. It feared.
The Hollow.Naturalist: Something alive survived the Hollow. You. And one or two things that followed you out.
The Hollow.Sorcerer: The Hollow runs on old grief. Your magic ran on something newer. It won.
The Hollow.Necromancer: The dead in the Hollow were not expecting a colleague.
The Hollow.Berserker: The Hollow is built on fear. You were not afraid. That was the only reason you survived.
The Hollow.Bard: You sang in the Hollow. The house went quiet. You kept singing. It stayed quiet.
The Hollow.Alchemist: You analyzed the Hollow. Filed a report. Left. Remarkable professional distance.
The Hollow.BloodKnight: The Hollow feeds on what you carry. You carry more than it could consume.
The Hollow.Druid: The Hollow had forgotten what growing things felt like. You reminded it.
The Hollow.Wizard: The Hollow is grief made architecture. You studied it, named every room, and walked out the front door.

The Whispering Forest.Warrior: The Forest whispered to you the whole way through. You did not listen. That is why you won.
The Whispering Forest.Monk: The Forest tried to root you in place. You moved anyway. Still and moving at once.
The Whispering Forest.Assassin: The Forest saw everything. You moved through its blind spots. There were exactly enough of them.
The Whispering Forest.Paladin: The divine light you carried kept the dark from the trees. The trees were grateful. So was everything else.
The Whispering Forest.Naturalist: The Forest recognized you. One living thing among many. It let you pass. Eventually.
The Whispering Forest.Sorcerer: The Forest is old magic and older grief. Your magic was newer. Louder. Less patient.
The Whispering Forest.Necromancer: The dead in the Forest had been waiting for orders. You gave them some.
The Whispering Forest.Berserker: The Forest tried to make you afraid of the dark. You set the dark on fire. Metaphorically.
The Whispering Forest.Bard: You sang back at the whispers. They went quiet. You kept singing.
The Whispering Forest.Alchemist: You identified thirty-seven new ingredients in the Forest. Professionally speaking, a very good run.
The Whispering Forest.BloodKnight: The Forest bleeds when you cut it. You made it bleed first.
The Whispering Forest.Druid: The Forest knew you. It did not expect you to know it back.
The Whispering Forest.Wizard: The Forest runs on whispered magic older than written language. You translated most of it. Then you ended it.

The Infernal Descent.Warrior: The Descent threw everything at you. You hit everything back. That is the whole story.
The Infernal Descent.Monk: The void tried to fill you with noise. You were already empty. In the useful way.
The Infernal Descent.Assassin: The Descent watches for what moves. You moved between the watching. Fast enough.
The Infernal Descent.Paladin: The divine light held. All the way down. Even here.
The Infernal Descent.Naturalist: Nothing natural lives in the Descent. Until you.
The Infernal Descent.Sorcerer: The Descent is void magic with no memory of light. Your magic remembered. Loudly.
The Infernal Descent.Necromancer: The things that live in the Descent are not dead. They wish they were. You helped.
The Infernal Descent.Berserker: The Descent broke everyone who came before you. You broke the Descent.
The Infernal Descent.Bard: You sang in the void. The void had never heard singing before. It will not forget.
The Infernal Descent.Alchemist: You catalogued the Descent. Filed a complete report. The DDDI was very pleased.
The Infernal Descent.BloodKnight: The Descent feeds on what you fear. You fear nothing. It went hungry.
The Infernal Descent.Druid: Nothing grows in the Descent. Something does now.
The Infernal Descent.Wizard: The Descent is pure void magic, ancient and patient. You were neither. You won anyway.

The Abyssal Deep.Warrior: The Deep tried to drown you in darkness. You held your breath longer than it expected.
The Abyssal Deep.Monk: The pressure down here would crush stone. You moved through it like water.
The Abyssal Deep.Assassin: The Deep is dark in every direction. You were darker. That is the advantage.
The Abyssal Deep.Paladin: The divine light does not bend under pressure. Neither did you.
The Abyssal Deep.Naturalist: The creatures of the Deep had never seen anything from the surface before. They will not forget.
The Abyssal Deep.Sorcerer: The Deep has been generating its own magic since before the continents settled. You outspent it.
The Abyssal Deep.Necromancer: The drowned dead of the Deep had been waiting a very long time. You gave them purpose.
The Abyssal Deep.Berserker: The Deep is patient in the way that only very old things can be patient. You were not patient. You won.
The Abyssal Deep.Bard: Sound moves differently this far down. Your voice carried anyway. The Leviathan listened.
The Abyssal Deep.Alchemist: Seventeen unknown compounds. Four new reactions. One complete dungeon clear. Excellent run.
The Abyssal Deep.BloodKnight: The pressure down here should have stopped your heart. It tried. You disagreed.
The Abyssal Deep.Druid: The Deep has its own ecosystem, ancient and complete. You walked through the middle of it and left it intact.
The Abyssal Deep.Wizard: The Leviathan is four thousand years old. Your arcane study took eleven minutes. You were thorough.
